主要内容: Nordic American Tankers Ltd, a marine transportation company, entered into sale agreements for the Nordic Aurora and Nordic Sprite for approximately $10.0 million each on November 30, 2018. The company currently operates a fleet of 23 vessels. Additionally, the company and its chief executive officer, Herbjørn Hansson, each hold 13.55% and 10.45% of the total shares outstanding of Nordic American Offshore Ltd. This information is incorporated into the company's registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-228603). The report was filed with the SEC on February 13, 2019, and signed by Herbjørn Hansson, the chairman, president, and chief executive officer of the company.
